body.summary: Added addAssignee(issue, who): PortResult<string[]> to TrackerPort (port.ts) and implemented it in the GitHub adapter beside setAssignee: it reads the assignees, makes a single gh issue edit --add-assignee call only when who is not already assigned (case-insensitive), re-reads, returns the assignees read back, and reports a re-read without who as rejected; a failed or timed-out step is a classified PortResult failure with no retry and no re-read. It never removes anyone. setAssignee is untouched. The method is the additive sc1 amendment AMD-315d510cb28100e2-12, still pending with s1. One test in github-adapter.test.ts covers adding from none and beside another assignee (no remove call), the already-assigned case, a sticky add (rejected), a timeout (unreachable, no retry, no re-read) and a malformed reference (no gh call).
